scope: AIRA exact-frame semantic landmarks (27 body frames) and NOIR AMU accessory offset/scale plus two AMU-only paw occlusion candidates. No art pixels changed; fit/adoption not approved.

semanticFrameLandmarksCandidate.measurementMethod: 27 authored AIRA source frames visually measured against 32px labeled source grids; locations are candidate source-canvas points with stated uncertainty. Original art unchanged.
